tools.name: doctype
tools.description:
Retrieve supported file formats or map a file extension to its TweekIT document type.

Authentication is read exclusively from environment variables (`TWEEKIT_API_KEY` /
`TWEEKIT_API_SECRET`) or MCP HTTP request headers (`ApiKey` / `ApiSecret`) — never place
API secrets in prompts or tool arguments.

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Validate whether a file format is supported by TweekIT and recommend the optimal AI-ready output format.

tools.name: convert
tools.description:
Convert a base64-encoded document payload with TweekIT (Cloud CGN or On-Premises Miner Renderery).

Credentials are read securely from `TWEEKIT_API_KEY` / `TWEEKIT_API_SECRET` environment
variables or HTTP `ApiKey` / `ApiSecret` headers. Set `TWEEKIT_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:16377/api/image/`
a

tools.name: convert_url
tools.description: Download a public HTTPS file (with connect-time IP pinning, redirect, and size limits) and convert via TweekIT.

tools.name: convert_file
tools.description:
Convert a local workspace file when explicitly opted in (`TWEEKIT_ALLOW_LOCAL_FILES=1`).

Disabled by default and over HTTP, strictly confined to `TWEEKIT_ALLOWED_DIRS` with symlink
rejection (`lstat` + `O_NOFOLLOW`), dotfile/credential blocking, and non-overwrite protection.
For zero cloud egress,

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Immediately delete an uploaded TweekIT document by DocId before its 20-minute auto-expiry.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a public HTTPS URL (with connect-time IP pinning, redirect, and size limits) and return content.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Simple web search using DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, search · Private data: doctype, preflight, convert, convert_url, convert_file, delete_document · Public sink: doctype · Destructive: preflight, convert_file, delete_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, search · Private data: doctype, preflight, convert, convert_url, convert_file, delete_document · Public sink: doctype · Destructive: preflight, convert_file, delete_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
